description.text: Griffiss Institute is a STEM talent and technology accelerator in Rome, NY, advancing innovation, internships, and collaboration with government, academia, and industry.

targetApplicants.text: Griffiss Institute empowers the next generation of STEM talent, disruptive technologies, and mission-driven startups to strengthen U.S. national security and expand economic opportunity for our region, state, and nation.
